title: Define legal move selection and model failure behavior
source: The owner asked 'let's move to the next ticket' in the research child thread.
pendingQuestion: After all four illegal-move attempts fail, should the match pause with Retry and Switch model options, or count as a model loss?
recommendation: Pause at the unchanged position and let the player choose how to continue.
priorModelSelectionTicket: KHA-9 remains in progress; the mid-match compatibility-check question is unanswered.
terminalSummary:
Recorded: four attempts per turn.

If all four fail, should the match **pause with Retry and Switch model options**, or count as a loss for the model?

I recommend pausing at the unchanged position and letting the player choose how to continue.
acceptedDecision: Do not supply a legal-move list or constrain the response to an enumeration of legal moves. The model proposes its own move and may receive corrections for mistakes.
acceptedDecisions: Do not supply a legal-move list or constrain the response to an enumeration of legal moves. The model proposes its own move and may receive corrections for mistakes.
Corrections explain the specific chess-rule violation without suggesting a replacement move or supplying the legal-move list. The model chooses its own replacement.

Allow three automatic correction retries after the initial illegal-move attempt, for four attempts total on the same turn. Exhaustion stops automatic retries and requires player action; the match outcome remains undecided.

acceptedRetryLimit.scope: Illegal-move correction only. Malformed responses, refusals, transport failures, and proxy-internal retries remain undecided.
